en: Color lithographic postcard with a pastoral vignette and a panoramic view of Marburg an der Drau (today Maribor) on the Drava River. A shepherd with sheep sits under a large tree in the foreground; the town and a long bridge over the river are in the background. Reverse shows an Austrian "Correspondenz-Karte," addressed in German to Laibach (Ljubljana) with a 5‑heller stamp and a 1904 Laibach postmark.
